verdict.rationale: Aider provides /ask for code-base Q&A, a repo map for navigation, /run and /test to reproduce issues and verify fixes, and /undo plus auto-commits to check regressions — community reports confirm it speeds up understanding unfamiliar codebases and locating relevant code. However, there's no dedicated debugging/root-cause-analysis feature (e.g., breakpoints, stack trace correlation) and some community feedback notes subtle errors and unreliable outputs on complex tasks. Missing for 10: dedicated root-cause/debugging tooling beyond running commands, independent verification of accuracy on complex bug reproduction.
